salesforce.hint: Instance URL like https://yourorg.my.salesforce.com + Connected App client_id/secret. For full CONNECTED add username + password+security_token.

zendesk.hint: Subdomain only (acme not acme.zendesk.com). Email + API token from Admin → Channels → API.

razorpay.hint: Dashboard → API Keys. Test keys start with rzp_test_.

stripe.hint: Secret key sk_test_... or sk_live_... from Stripe Dashboard.

slack_webhook.hint: Incoming Webhook URL from Slack app.
